| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Regions | Regions, Boundaries over the image, Mean color of each region | The regions as a label map, drawn over the image and listed in the Features panel. Or the boundaries in yellow over the image, or each region filled with its mean color. |
| **Scale** `scale` | 1 | 0.1 to 5000 | How strongly small regions prefer to merge. scikit-image uses 1. |
| **Smoothing** `sigma` | 0.8 | 0 to 5 px | The sigma of a Gaussian blur before the graph is built. scikit-image uses 0.8. |
| **Smallest region** `minSize` | 20 | 1 to 10000 px | Regions smaller than this join a neighbor at the end. scikit-image uses 20. |
